primary_source.title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents

verified_observations: HEP represents each hypothesis as a persistent identity with an append-only event log; events are author-stamped and hash-chained, and current lifecycle state/belief are obtained by replaying the log.
The registry records a testable predicted observable and lineage. Inspired-by is provenance rather than descendant lineage.

Belief changes are accepted only through an attached evidence item that passes the protocol validation gate. Supported requires P(H)>=0.8 and refuted requires P(H)<=0.2; invalid lifecycle moves and verdicts before threshold crossing are rejected. Refine/merge require a parent verdict or at least one attached evidence item.

The planning-style comparison uses the same research goal, the same computational tools, and the same base LLM, with n=3 runs per condition. Reported process values match the primary source: planning tests=83%, belief updates=0%, H->T=1.00, T->E=0.61; HEP H->T=0.85, T->E=0.58, E->B=0.78, B->J=0.40, J->U=0.22, U->T=0.65.
Across three materials tasks, HEP generated 10-20 hypotheses per task at maximum generation depth 3-5 and left no hypothesis in proposed/under_test state at run end.

On AO2 with only the base LLM changed under identical prompts, tools, and stopping conditions, n=3 per LLM, mean hypothesis count/depth are 14.7/4.7 for GPT-5.5, 6.7/1.7 for GPT-5.4-mini, and 4.0/0.7 for GPT-4.1. GPT-5.4-mini leaves 36% open on average; GPT-4.1 is unstable across its three runs.
The paper states that final governing rules were tested on compositions not examined when the rules were formed.
The paper states source code will be made publicly available upon publication; the v1 preprint itself does not provide a released implementation artifact for independent rerun.

scope_corrections.correction: The process comparison is not a single-variable ablation of an evidence gate or registry. The HEP arm receives HEP tools plus a hypothesis-discipline prompt and no planning tools; the baseline is a planning-style scaffold. The paper also states that the two conditions stop under different criteria. Therefore the intervention is a bundled harness/tool/prompt/stopping-policy change, despite matched research goal, computational tools, and base LLM.

The loop-transition statistic is partly instrumentation-coupled. HEP tool calls map deterministically into H/E/B/U categories, while free-text steps are classified by GPT-5.5. The strong evidence is that HEP externalizes and routes belief mutations through explicit typed operations; the reported transition matrix is not an independent measure of deeper scientific reasoning quality.

Evidence validation is not independent in this study. For computational and analytical evidence, the same agent certifies method adequacy and result validity before belief may move. The authors explicitly identify programmatic checks or an independent auditor agent as future work.

No matched final scientific-correctness/quality advantage over the planning baseline is established. The primary evidence supports auditability and process/lifecycle discipline, not improved scientific truth.
All scientific evidence is at a fixed MLIP fidelity. Testing governing rules on previously unexamined compositions is an internal predictive check, not first-principles or experimental ground truth.
n=3 per condition/model is small, and the code is not yet a released independently rerunnable artifact in v1.

assessment.supported_claim: HEP provides a concrete event-sourced, evidence-gated hypothesis/belief lifecycle and, in the reported materials-agent experiments, causes belief/evidence/lifecycle operations to be explicit and auditable rather than remaining only in an unstructured planning loop.
not_supported: HEP alone, isolated from prompt/tool/stopping differences, causes the reported process changes.
HEP improves final scientific correctness versus the planning baseline.
The self-certified evidence gate is equivalent to independent evidence validation.
The released implementation has been independently rerun.

next_verification.question: Verify the 2.1% strategy-change denominator/recognizer, experience-driven score deltas, 7.9x compute statement, and whether strategy-change classification or follow-up interventions materially confound the claim that high-level strategy remains locked after execution begins.
